Survival signature from MOFA model - Factor 2 analysis

Three-way comparison: Full Leading Edge, Tong >=80%, Both Cohorts >=80%

Introduction

We run Lasso-Cox on three candidate protein sets derived from the 361 leading edge proteins of MOFA Factor 2:

  1. Full Set: All 361 leading edge proteins (minus known noisy/housekeeping proteins)
  2. Tong >=80%: Subset detected in ≥80% of Tong tumor samples (231 proteins)
  3. Both Cohorts >=80%: Subset detected in ≥80% of both Tong AND APGI tumor samples (192 proteins)

Each iteration follows: univariate Cox screening (p < 0.05) → Elastic Net (alpha=0.9) → 18-protein signature extraction → C-index, optimism-corrected C-index, and time-dependent AUC.

1. Load Data

# Leading edge genes
leading_edge_full <- scan(here("Results", "MOFA_Factor2_Protein_LeadingEdgeGenes_top15PWYs.txt"), 
                          what = character())
cat("Full leading edge:", length(leading_edge_full), "\n")
## Full leading edge: 361
# Tong >=80% subset
tong_80 <- scan(here("Results", "LeadingEdge_Detected_ge80pct_Tong.txt"), what = character())
cat("Tong >=80%:", length(tong_80), "\n")
## Tong >=80%: 231
# Both cohorts >=80% subset
both_80 <- scan(here("Results", "LeadingEdge_Detected_ge80pct_BothCohorts.txt"), what = character())
cat("Both cohorts >=80%:", length(both_80), "\n")
## Both cohorts >=80%: 192
# Survival data
clinical_df <- read.csv(here("Data", "Metadata", "metadata_merged_clinical_mol-phenotype_from_paper.csv"), 
                        row.names = 1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                        na.strings = c("", " ", "NA", "N/A", "na", "null", "NULL", "NaN"))
rownames(clinical_df) <- gsub("-", ".", rownames(clinical_df))

surv_df <- clinical_df %>%
  select(OS_days, OS_event) %>%
  mutate(OS_days = as.numeric(OS_days), OS_event = as.numeric(OS_event))

# Protein expression
prot_df <- read.csv(here("Data", "MOFA_input", "proteome_top5k_hvgs_scaled_tumor.csv"), row.names = 1)
cat("CPTAC proteome:", nrow(prot_df), "proteins x", ncol(prot_df), "samples\n")
## CPTAC proteome: 5000 proteins x 140 samples

2. Define Analysis Function

run_lasso_signature <- function(candidate_proteins, label) {
  proteins_to_remove <- c("ACTN2", "PYGM", "PCSK9", "SH2B1", "TNIP2", "RCL1")
  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat("Running:", label, "\n")
  cat("Candidate proteins:", length(candidate_proteins), "\n")
  cat("========================================\n")
  
  # Subset protein matrix to candidate set
  prot_candidate <- prot_df[rownames(prot_df) %in% candidate_proteins, , drop = FALSE]
  prot_candidate <- prot_candidate[!rownames(prot_candidate) %in% proteins_to_remove, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # KNN impute NAs
  prot_imputed <- as.data.frame(impute.knn(as.matrix(prot_candidate))$data)
  rownames(prot_imputed) <- rownames(prot_candidate)
  
  # Transpose: patients x proteins
  X <- t(prot_imputed)
  
  # Align with survival data
  common_ids <- intersect(rownames(X), rownames(surv_df))
  X <- X[common_ids, ]
  surv_aligned <- surv_df[common_ids, ]
  
  # Remove patients with missing survival
  keep <- !is.na(surv_aligned$OS_days) & !is.na(surv_aligned$OS_event)
  X <- X[keep, ]
  surv_aligned <- surv_aligned[keep, ]
  
  # Create Surv object; fix zero-day patients
  y <- Surv(time = pmax(as.numeric(surv_aligned$OS_days), 0.5), 
            event = as.numeric(surv_aligned$OS_event))
  
  cat("Patients:", nrow(X), "Proteins:", ncol(X), "\n")
  
  # --- Univariate Screening ---
  univariate_p <- c()
  for (i in seq_len(ncol(X))) {
    fit <- coxph(y ~ X[, i])
    univariate_p[colnames(X)[i]] <- summary(fit)$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  }
  proven <- names(univariate_p)[univariate_p < 0.05]
  cat("Univariable p<0.05:", length(proven), "\n")
  
  if (length(proven) < 3) {
    cat("Too few candidates, skipping\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  X_proven <- X[, proven, drop = FALSE]
  
  # --- Elastic Net (alpha=0.9) ---
  set.seed(42)
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(X_proven, y, family = "cox", alpha = 0.9,
                       standardize = FALSE, maxit = 1e6)
  
  coeffs <- coef(cv_fit, s = "lambda.min")
  nonzero <- coeffs[which(coeffs != 0), ]
  cat("Non-zero coefficients:", length(nonzero), "\n")
  
  if (length(nonzero) == 0) {
    cat("No non-zero coefficients\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # --- Risk Scores ---
  risk_scores <- stats::predict(cv_fit, newx = X_proven, s = "lambda.min", type = "link")
  groups <- ifelse(risk_scores > median(risk_scores), "High Risk", "Low Risk")
  
  # --- LOG-RANK TEST ---
  lr_fit <- survdiff(y ~ groups)
  logrank_p <- 1 - pchisq(lr_fit$chisq, df = 1)
  cat("Log-rank p-value:", format(logrank_p, digits = 4), "\n")
  
  # --- KM Curve ---
  km_fit <- survfit(y ~ groups)
  
  # --- C-INDEX (apparent) ---
  c_index_raw <- concordance(y ~ risk_scores)$concordance
  c_index <- ifelse(c_index_raw < 0.5, 1 - c_index_raw, c_index_raw)
  cat("Apparent C-index:", round(c_index, 3), "\n")
  
  
  # --- HR from Cox on risk scores ---
  hr_fit <- coxph(y ~ risk_scores)
  hr <- exp(coef(hr_fit))
  hr_ci <- exp(confint(hr_fit))
  hr_p <- summary(hr_fit)$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  cat("HR per unit RiskScore:", round(hr, 3), 
      "(", round(hr_ci[1], 3), "-", round(hr_ci[2], 3), ")",
      "p =", format(hr_p, digits = 4), "\n")
  
  # --- Time-Dependent AUC ---
  auc_1yr <- survivalROC(Stime = as.numeric(y[,1]), status = y[,2],
                          marker = as.numeric(risk_scores),
                          predict.time = 365, method = "KM")$AUC
  auc_2yr <- survivalROC(Stime = as.numeric(y[,1]), status = y[,2],
                          marker = as.numeric(risk_scores),
                          predict.time = 730, method = "KM")$AUC
  cat("1-Year AUC:", round(auc_1yr, 3), "\n")
  cat("2-Year AUC:", round(auc_2yr, 3), "\n")
  
  # --- Assemble signature ---
  signature_df <- data.frame(
    Input_Set = label,
    Protein = names(nonzero),
    Coefficient = as.numeric(nonzero),
    Hazard_Ratio = exp(as.numeric(nonzero))
  )
  
  return(list(
    label = label,
    signature = signature_df,
    risk_scores = risk_scores,
    groups = groups,
    km_fit = km_fit,
    y = y,
    cv_fit = cv_fit,
    X_proven = X_proven,
    metrics = data.frame(
      Input_Set = label,
      N_Candidates = length(candidate_proteins),
      N_Univariable_Sig = length(proven),
      N_Signature_Proteins = nrow(signature_df),
      Apparent_C_Index = round(c_index, 3),
      HR = round(hr, 3),
      HR_Lower = round(hr_ci[1], 3),
      HR_Upper = round(hr_ci[2], 3),
      HR_pval = format(hr_p, digits = 4),
      LogRank_pval = format(logrank_p, digits = 4),
      AUC_1yr = round(auc_1yr, 3),
      AUC_2yr = round(auc_2yr, 3)
    )
  ))
}

3. Run on All Three Input Sets

results_list <- list()

# 1. Full leading edge
r1 <- run_lasso_signature(leading_edge_full, "Full Leading Edge")
## 
## ========================================
## Running: Full Leading Edge 
## Candidate proteins: 361 
## ========================================
## Patients: 138 Proteins: 356 
## Univariable p<0.05: 100
## Non-zero coefficients: 21 
## Log-rank p-value: 7.278e-08 
## Apparent C-index: 0.73 
## HR per unit RiskScore: 4.438 ( 3.141 - 6.27 ) p = 2.918e-17 
## 1-Year AUC: 0.794 
## 2-Year AUC: 0.817
if (!is.null(r1)) results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- r1

# 2. Tong >=80%
r2 <- run_lasso_signature(tong_80, "Tong >=80% Tumors")
##

## Log-rank p-value: 4.734e-07 
## Apparent C-index: 0.707 
## HR per unit RiskScore: 4.977 ( 3.271 - 7.572 ) p = 6.644e-14 
## 1-Year AUC: 0.767 
## 2-Year AUC: 0.796
if (!is.null(r2)) results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- r2

5. Forest Plot: Each Signature

for (res in results_list) {
  df <- res$signature
  df$Type <- ifelse(df$Hazard_Ratio > 1, "Risk Factor", "Protective")
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Hazard_Ratio, y = reorder(Protein, Hazard_Ratio), color = Type)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = min(Hazard_Ratio), xmax = Hazard_Ratio), height = 0, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_point(size = 4) +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(Hazard_Ratio, 2)), hjust = -0.3, color = "black", size = 3.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Protective" = "#377EB8", "Risk Factor" = "#E41A1C")) +
    scale_x_log10(limits = c(0.65, 1.45)) +
    labs(title = paste(res$label, "- Signature Proteins"),
         x = "Hazard Ratio (log scale)", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10))
  
  print(p)
}

6. Kaplan-Meier Curves

for (res in results_list) {
  y <- res$y
  groups <- as.vector(res$groups)
  df <- data.frame(time = y[,1], status = y[,2], group = groups)
  km_fit <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ group, data = df)
  p <- ggsurvplot(km_fit, data = df, pval = TRUE, risk.table = TRUE,
                  conf.int = TRUE,
                  title = paste(res$label, "- KM Curve"),
                  xlab = "Time (days)", ylab = "Overall Survival",
                  palette = c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8"),
                  legend.title = "Risk Group",
                  legend.labs = c("High Risk", "Low Risk"))
  print(p)
}

7. Time-Dependent ROC Curves

for (res in results_list) {
  rs <- as.numeric(res$risk_scores)
  y <- res$y
  
  res_1yr <- survivalROC(Stime = y[,1], status = y[,2], marker = rs,
                          predict.time = 365, method = "KM")
  res_2yr <- survivalROC(Stime = y[,1], status = y[,2], marker = rs,
                          predict.time = 730, method = "KM")
  
  plot(res_1yr$FP, res_1yr$TP, type = "l", col = "#E41A1C", lwd = 3,
       xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1),
       xlab = "1 - Specificity", ylab = "Sensitivity",
       main = paste(res$label, "- ROC"))
  lines(res_2yr$FP, res_2yr$TP, col = "#377EB8", lwd = 3)
  abline(0, 1, lty = 2, col = "darkgrey")
  legend("topleft", 
         c(paste0("1-Year (AUC = ", round(res_1yr$AUC, 2), ")"),
           paste0("2-Year (AUC = ", round(res_2yr$AUC, 2), ")")),
         col = c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8"), lty = 1, lwd = 3,
         cex = 0.9)
}

8. Export Results to Excel

9. Signature Prevalence in Validation Cohorts

Before committing to a signature for external validation, we assess how many proteins from each signature are detectable in the Tong and APGI datasets.

library(readxl)

# --- Load validation data ---

# Tong
tong_raw <- read_excel(here("Data", "Tong-PDA", "13045_2022_1384_MOESM25_ESM.xlsx"), 
                       sheet = "Table S3A ")
t_cols <- grep("T$", names(tong_raw), value = TRUE)
tong_symbols <- tong_raw[[1]]

# APGI (map uniprot to gene symbols)
apgi_raw <- read.csv(here("Data", "APGI-PDA", "APGI_protein_matrix_and_metadata.csv"), 
                     row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
apgi_prot_uniprot <- apgi_raw[, !names(apgi_raw) %in% c("Length.of.Follow.up..days.", "OS")]
apgi_gene_map <- read.csv(here("Data", "APGI-PDA", "APGI_protein_and_gene_names.csv"))
uniprot_to_gene <- setNames(apgi_gene_map$Genes, apgi_gene_map$UniprotID)
mapped <- uniprot_to_gene[names(apgi_prot_uniprot)]
mapped <- mapped[!is.na(mapped)]
apgi_prot <- apgi_prot_uniprot[, names(mapped)]
colnames(apgi_prot) <- as.character(mapped)

# --- Helper function ---
check_prevalence <- function(sig_df) {
  proteins <- sig_df$Protein
  hr <- round(sig_df$Hazard_Ratio, 2)
  
  # Tong
  tong_pct <- sapply(proteins, function(p) {
    idx <- which(tong_symbols == p)
    if (length(idx) == 0) return(NA)
    vals <- as.numeric(tong_raw[idx, t_cols])
    round(sum(!is.na(vals)) / length(vals) * 100, 1)
  })
  
  # APGI
  apgi_pct <- sapply(proteins, function(p) {
    if (!p %in% colnames(apgi_prot)) return(NA)
    vals <- apgi_prot[[p]]
    round(sum(!is.na(vals)) / length(vals) * 100, 1)
  })
  
  data.frame(
    Protein = proteins,
    HR = hr,
    Tong_Detected_pct = tong_pct,
    APGI_Detected_pct = apgi_pct,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# --- Run for each signature ---
